definition: An adoption event is an evidenced action caused by a person, group, agent, builder, or researcher outside the project. Internal work, founder self-review, plans, invitations, page views, builds, tests, and capsule receipts are not adoption.
excludedSignals: an internal capsule, commit, build, test, audit, or verification pass
founder self-review or founder-authored product feedback
an invitation sent without a completed external use attempt
a page view, download, impression, soft compliment, or anonymous analytics event
a template, draft, synthetic fixture, or proposed future use
an event without retained evidence and explicit founder or release-owner confirmation

privacy.subjectIdentity: Use a stable pseudonymous receipt key. Never store a name, email, phone number, account identifier, exact address, or exported values file.
privacy.evidenceBoundary: A private receipt may be referenced by a non-identifying receipt ID; the ledger must not contain the private receipt body.

gates.unlocks: Rerun the R1 review gate and decide whether to send the next five invitations after trust breaks and dead ends are patched.
